questions.expl: 本文介绍介绍一只名叫吉米·奇波拉塔医疗狗。
判断题。根据第二段“There, he found a little bird with a broken wing, struggling to fly. ”可知， 小鸟的翅膀受了伤，由此推测，Sammy 决定帮助小鸟是因为他不想让这只小鸟受苦。故选B。
理解题。根据倒数第三段“It quickly flew to the nearby animals and asked for help. ”可知，作为 回报，小鸟通过让其他动物一起帮忙来帮助Sammy。故选C。

猜测题。根据倒数第三段“Not long after, a terrible storm attacked the forest, and Sammy’s tree hole was blocked by fallen branches. Sammy was caught and he didn’t know what to do. ”可知，由于一 场可怕的风暴袭击了森林，Sammy 的树洞被倒下的树枝堵住了，他被困在了树洞里，他不知道该 怎么办。由此猜测，predicament 意为“a great difficulty for Sammy”。故选A。
：一扇是美丽的客厅门，另一扇是丑陋的浴室门。 new 新的；ugly 丑陋的；heavy 重的；light 轻的。根据最后一段“the not so good-looking bathroom door” 可知，浴室门是丑陋的。故选B。
：屋子里到处都是顽皮的孩子，他们总是摔门、踢门。 naughty 调皮的；wise 智慧的；nervous 紧张的；polite 礼貌的。根据“slamming and kicking the doors” 可知，会摔门和踢门的孩子是调皮的。故选A。
：每天晚上，每个人都在睡觉时，门们会谈论它们的不幸。 dreams 梦想；appearances 外貌；experiences 经历；houses 房子。根据前文“slamming and kicking the doors”可知门被粗鲁地对待，是不好的经历。故选C。
：等一等，事情会有所改善。 matter 要紧；improve 提高；repeat 重复；suffer 遭受。根据语境“Don’t worry. They’re children. They’ll soon learn. ”可知，事情会改善的。故选B。
：但是有一天，在一次大型聚会和多次摔门、踢门之后，客厅的门终于发脾气了。 seldom 很少；luckily 幸运地；happily 开心地；finally 最终。根据“That’s enough”可知门受够了，最 终发脾气了。故选D。
：下次有人猛摔我时，我就破掉，他们就会知道我有多重要。 laugh 笑；break 打破；work 工作；cry 哭。根据“the living-room door broke”可知，门坏了，故选B。
：这给房子造成了很大的麻烦，孩子们受到了惩罚。 joy 快乐；excitement 激动；surprise 惊讶；trouble 麻烦。根据“the living-room door broke”可知门坏 了，给房子造成了麻烦。故选D。
：他们决定购买一个新的，而不是修好它。 selling 卖；repairing 修理；painting 绘画；finding 找到。根据“they decided to buy a new one”可知他 们打算买新门，没打算修理。故选B。
：由于不够耐心，他现在被抛弃了，等待被变成柴火。 beautiful 漂亮的；careful 认真的；patient 有耐心的；friendly 友好的。根据“Wait and things will …” 可知，劝说要等待，说明不够耐心。故选C。
本文是一篇记叙文。主要介绍了孩子们经常摔打家里的两扇门，对此起居室的门和浴室的 门做出了不同的反应，起居室的门坏了，虽然它比浴室的门漂亮，可是最终没有逃脱被抛弃的命运。

questions.stem: What was Sammy famous for in the forest?
opts: His skill of making tree holes.
His warm heart in protecting the forest.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据第一段“Sammy was known for his kind and helpful nature. ”可知，Sammy 以其 善良和乐于助人的天性而闻名。故选C。

questions.stem: Why did Sammy decide to help the little bird?
opts: He wanted to show how strong he was.
He didn’t want to let the bird suffer.
He planned to carry it back to his tree hole.
He needed the bird to help him collect nuts.
questions.expl: 后文“You don’t have to feed it. You don’t have to walk it …”此处应是总述机器人宠物有很多 优点。选项B“机器人宠物有很多好处。”符合语境。故选B。

questions.stem: How did the bird help Sammy in return?
opts: By catching him in a terrible storm.
By helping him carry away the leaves.
By asking other animals to help together.
By showing him where to get free from the hole.
questions.expl: “You don’t have to walk it …And you can go on holidays without feeling bad,”可知，此处应是 与机器人宠物的具体的优点有关。选项A“它不会把你的房子弄得一团糟。”符合语境。故选A。

questions.stem: What does the underlined word “predicament” probably mean?
opts: A place that Sammy liked to hide.
A chance for Sammy to get free.
A serious illness that Sammy suffered from.
questions.expl: 本文主要讲述了善良的松鼠Sammy 乐于助人，当他陷入困境时，周围的小动物都纷纷来 帮助他的故事。

questions.stem: Why are dogs often called “man’s best friend”?
opts: Because they are the most popular pets.
Because they can perform various tasks for humans.
Because they offer unconditional love and practical assistance.
Because they are easy to train.
questions.expl: 前文“Jean-Loup Rault, PhD, is an animal scientist at the University of Melbourne in Australia. ” 介绍了让-卢普·劳尔特的身份，后文他提及电子宠物鸡及大公司对其的改进，D 选项“他认为机器 人宠物将成为我们的新宠物。”承接上文介绍的人物，引出下文他对机器人宠物的相关表述，符合 语境。故选D。

questions.stem: How do cats help reduce stress?
opts: By always being affectionate and clingy.
By purring and seeking attention in a gentle way.
By playing energetic games with their owners.
By being independent and not demanding much attention.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Cats…A purring cat curled up on our laps can bring a sense of calm and relaxation…. their gentle nuzzles and soft meows when they seek attention show their love…Cats can also be great for reducing stress”可知，猫通过咕噜咕噜叫、用温柔的方式寻求关注来帮助减压。故 选B。 3. 细节理解题。根据“Small pets like rabbits…also offer unique forms of companionship…Watching these small creatures go about their daily activities, such as nibbling on food or playing around in their cages, can be a source of simple joy”可知，小型宠物提供独特的陪伴和简单的快乐，故选B。

questions.stem: What is the significance (重要性) of small pets like rabbits and guinea pigs in human-pet relationships?
opts: They are mainly for show and decoration.
They offer unique forms of companionship and simple joy.
They are more intelligent than other pets.
They require very little care compared to dogs and cats.

questions.stem: What does the author mean by “the relationship between pets and humans is a two-way street”?
opts: Pets and humans should walk on the street together.
Both pets and humans should be trained.
Humans should only focus on taking care of pets.
Pets give and get care and love from humans.
questions.expl: “When a Japanese robot seal (海豹) called Paro was introduced to hospital patients, it helped improve their moods and helped them make friends with others. ”可知，此处应是引出机器人宠物在实 际应用中的积极作用。选项E“但有些研究表明，智能机器是有帮助的。”符合语境。故选E。
